## Findings

### Blocking

- [BLOCKING] `os.unlink(os.path.join(directory, name))` deletes archives referenced by unfinished claims. Reproduced with the default retention of 10: after a crash and an origin rewrite, ten newer archives cause trimming to delete the claim's only recoverable bytes. Exclude archives referenced by outstanding claims from retention cleanup. (original severity: error)

### Advisory

- `_unlink_logged(project_dir, marker["handover"])` can delete a newer handover written after the preceding read. The Write tool does not acquire the project lock. Reproduced by rewriting between read and unlink: the newer bytes disappeared and were absent from the archive. Coordinate deletion with writers or retain the mutable source. Severity capped for the prior-fix change. (severity: warning)
- `"transcript": transcript_work.position(transcript_path),` captures the cursor after reading the handover and identifying the process. Concurrent work completed during that interval falls before the cursor; its PreToolUse also finds no ready marker to invalidate. Reproduced a Bash call and result being skipped, leaving the stale handover eligible for automatic injection. Anchor freshness checks to the handover write. (severity: warning)
- `entries = handover_injection.resume_entries(session.project_dir, session.session_id)` rebuilds the numbered list when processing a selection. A handover arriving after the user sees the list changes the numbering. Reproduced `resume 1` consuming a different origin than the displayed number 1. Preserve the displayed mapping or use stable identifiers. (severity: warning)
- ADR-005: `os.replace(source, target)` performs the ready-to-outdated transition without first recording it in a canonical NDJSON ledger. This transition prevents automatic injection, while injections.jsonl records only delivery attempts. Reproduced invalidation with no ledger created. Record the rotation decision before changing its marker. (severity: warning)
